name: @gjsify/gamepad-native
description: SDL3's gamepad subsystem, statically linked and trimmed, behind a GObject API that speaks the W3C standard layout — the backend of @gjsify/gamepad (ADR 0075). Contains no JavaScript; the prebuilt library and typelib arrive through per-target optionalDependencies.

osNotes.linux: Builds for linux-x64 and linux-arm64 with only libc, libm and the host GLib as load-time dependencies (libudev and D-Bus are dlopen()ed by SDL). A virtual uinput controller connects, reports buttons and axes, and disconnects in CI; a real controller has not been checked yet, and until SDL is compared against libmanette on real hardware (ADR 0075 Amendment 1) @gjsify/gamepad keeps libmanette as the Linux default.
osNotes.darwin: Builds, loads and enumerates on macOS 15+ with only system frameworks and the host GLib as runtime dependencies (measured on arm64; darwin-x64 is built by CI). Input from a real controller has not been verified yet (ADR 0075 stage 4).
osNotes.win32: Builds with MSVC as @gjsify/gamepad-native-win32-x64, linking only Windows system DLLs, and initialises, enumerates zero devices and shuts down under Node through @gjsify/node-gi in CI. Input from a real controller has not been verified yet (ADR 0075 stage 4).

scripts.build:meson: gjsify run init:meson && meson compile -C build
scripts.test: echo 'native only — see test:meson (runs on every prebuild leg)'
